A FEW LITTLE DETAILS

Before you
say yes.

Everything you might be wondering.

How does the shareable invitation link work?

Your personalized details are included in the link itself. Copy it after creating your invitation, then send it to your guests. Anyone with that link can open it, so include only details you’re comfortable sharing. The link works while this website is hosted.

Can I try a design before choosing it?

Of course. Select “Live preview” on any design to explore its opening, story, events, map links and RSVP. Choose “Make it yours” when you find your favourite.

How do guest RSVPs reach us?

Add your host WhatsApp number when personalizing. Guests fill in their RSVP, review the prepared message and send it to you in WhatsApp. Replies are delivered in WhatsApp; this website does not maintain a guest database.

Can I edit my invitation later?

Your most recent draft is saved in this browser. Select “My invitation” to edit it. After making changes, copy and send the new link; previously shared links keep their original details.

Is ₹699 a one-time design price?

Yes, the displayed design price is ₹699. You can preview, personalize and export on this site. Online payment is not connected, and creating a preview does not place a paid order.

Will my invitation work on mobile?

Yes. Invitations adapt to phones, tablets and desktops and open in a web browser. Guests do not need to install an app.
